name: s1-baseline
description: Billing-issue ticket, stateless agent. The customer never states their email until asked directly — and a second session shows zero continuity.

messages: Hi — I think I was double-charged for my Acme Cloud Compute subscription this month. Can you check?
I'm on the Pro plan, if that helps. The charge was $49, twice, on the same day.
While you're at it — is the Billing API having issues today? Our webhook deliveries look delayed.

sessions.comment: The customer 'returns' in a new chat. Watch the agent ask who they are again.
messages: Hi, it's me again — about that double charge from earlier. Any update?
I'm Maya Chen, from Northwind Robotics. We talked about the duplicate $49 charge for Acme Cloud Compute.
